lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\MFAChecker\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

2 inline styles in templates/. The default Content Security Policy of the server allows inline style; a response whose policy disallows it drops them. A stylesheet added with OCP\Util::addStyle() holds in both cases.
